subject: reps needs gate.sham and a recovery signal
body: Reps will honour DetectionEvent.gate.sham and never roll its own sham (D-reps-004); please roll it once in the gate, default rate 0.25, configurable to 0 or pinned per trial in the scripted demo scenario. Reps also needs a recovery signal per detection: e.g. onRecovered(detectionEventId, t) when signals return inside the person's on-state band, or a predicate over SignalFrames. Recovery window 180 s, after which reps logs it as censored. Which shape suits you?
